items.h: Boston Today and Tonight: Lisiecki, Hip-Hop Hall of Fame, Passim
items.sum: Jan Lisiecki plays Mendelssohn at Symphony Hall at 7:30 PM, the Berklee Hip-Hop Hall of Fame celebration starts at 8:00 PM and a City Hall artist talk runs from 6:00 to 8:00 PM.

items.h: Handel and Haydn's Messiah at Symphony Hall, Nov. 27-29
items.sum: Harry Christophers leads the Handel and Haydn Society in its 173rd annual Messiah Nov. 27, 28 and 29 at Symphony Hall, Boston.

items.h: Doja Cat Brings 'Tour Ma Vie' to TD Garden on Nov. 23 With Latto
items.sum: The Grammy winner's world tour hits Causeway Street the Monday before Thanksgiving, with Latto as special guest.

items.h: Sing We Noel: Christmas Music From England and Early America
items.sum: Sunday, December 6, at 6:30 PM at Gordon Chapel in Old South Church, Back Bay.

items.h: Kapilow and A Far Cry Unpack Mozart's Clarinet Concerto, Nov. 22
items.sum: Sunday, Nov. 22 at 3:00 PM at NEC's Jordan Hall in Fenway: Rob Kapilow, A Far Cry and clarinetist Romie de Guise-Langlois take on Mozart's Clarinet Concerto.

items.h: Masterworks Chorale Sings Mozart's Coronation Mass, Nov. 22
items.sum: Sunday, Nov. 22 from 3:00 to 5:00 PM at Cary Memorial Hall in Lexington: Masterworks Chorale, Kevin Leong and the Pro Arte Chamber Orchestra.

items.h: Picasso, Miró and Dalí Turn the Page at the MFA Through Jan. 24
items.sum: Through January 24, 2027, the MFA's Torf Gallery shows Spanish artists' illustrated books, with a virtual lecture on December 9 at 6:30 PM.

items.h: Earl Lee Leads Tchaikovsky's Fourth at Symphony Hall, Nov. 24-25
items.sum: Franck, Tomasi and Tchaikovsky on one program, with saxophonist Steven Banks, at 1:30 PM on Nov. 24 and 8:00 PM on Nov. 25 at Symphony Hall.

items.h: Places We Carry: Juried Student Show Opens at the MFA, Nov. 21
items.sum: Opens Saturday, Nov. 21, in the Edward H. Linde Gallery, with work by five emerging artists.

items.h: SoWa Christmas Market Opens Nov. 20 With 100-Plus Local Makers
items.sum: Opening night is Friday, November 20, from 4:00 to 9:00 PM at SoWa Power Station in the South End.

items.h: Boston Tuba Christmas Brings Brass to The Steps Plaza, Nov. 28
items.sum: Saturday, November 28, from 12:30 to 1:30 PM at The Steps Plaza in Downtown Boston, with a festive tuba and brass program.

items.h: Quincy Market Tree Lighting Is Saturday, Nov. 21, From 2:00 to 6:00 PM
items.sum: Faneuil Hall Marketplace holds its annual lighting with Make-A-Wish and Santa, and admission is at no charge.

items.h: Coltrane 100 Tribute Brings Five Players to Berklee, Nov. 21
items.sum: Saturday, Nov. 21, at 8:00 PM at the Berklee Performance Center in Back Bay, with Joe Lovano, Melissa Aldana, Leo Genovese, Linda May Han Oh and Jeff 'Tain' Watts.

items.h: Convivium Sings A North Atlantic Christmas in Brookline, Nov. 21
items.sum: Saturday, Nov. 21, from 7:00 to 8:30 PM at All Saints Parish, 1773 Beacon Street, with tickets at $25.

items.h: Oriana Consort Sings Tennyson, Folk Songs and Poulenc, Nov. 22
items.sum: Sunday, Nov. 22 at 5:00 PM at First Lutheran Church on Berkeley Street in Back Bay: the Oriana Consort's fall concert.

items.h: Bruce Molsky Plays Old-Time Fiddle at Club Passim, Nov. 22
items.sum: Sunday, Nov. 22, with doors at 1:00 PM and the show at 2:00 PM at Club Passim in Cambridge.

items.h: Copley Square Tree Lighting Is Monday, Nov. 30, at 5:00 PM
items.sum: Boston Parks and Recreation hosts the annual tree lighting at Copley Square Plaza.

items.h: Dinty Child and Mark Erelli Share Songs at Club Passim, Nov. 27
items.sum: Friday, Nov. 27, with doors at 6:00 PM and the show at 7:00 PM at Club Passim in Cambridge.

items.h: Laurie MacAllister and Seth Glier Sing at Club Passim, Nov. 21
items.sum: Saturday, Nov. 21, with doors at 7:00 PM and the show at 8:00 PM at Club Passim in Cambridge.
